newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down as positions liquidated.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down as positions liquidated.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended down on Thursday from its previous New York close as punters liquidated positions ahead of the Easter holiday weekend that runs from Friday to Monday, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$349.60/350.10 an ounce against New York's US$350.10/60 close on Wednesday.
Morning trade saw some selling from several U.S. funds which was absorbed by buying from Tokyo, dealers said.
Other bullion traders reported selling interest later from Tokyo which pushed gold back down again.
Some dealers reported European sales in the afternoon.
Gold could test higher levels at US$352 per ounce next week, some said.
Local gold ended HK$25 higher at HK$3,243 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society remained unchanged from its previous fix at -8.00
